text: {"components": [{"type": "entity", "quote": "Union internationale des télécommunications (UIT)", "gist": "International Telecommunication Union (ITU)"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Doreen Bogdan-Martin", "gist": "Doreen Bogdan-Martin"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "projet GIGA", "gist": "GIGA project"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "L’UIT s’efforce de donner accès aux services et aux contenus numériques à un maximum de personnes et d’entreprises.", "gist": "ITU strives to provide digital services and content to as many people and businesses as possible."}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "Avec le projet GIGA, l’UIT a pour objectif de connecter toutes les écoles du monde à Internet d’ici 2030.", "gist": "Through the GIGA project, ITU aims to connect all the world's schools to the Internet by 2030."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "d’ici 2030", "gist": "by 2030"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Genève", "gist": "Geneva"}]}
